seen.body:
## Problem

Owner wants epic rows to show done and in progress racing: [####==----] 40% done 20% in progress 4/10 (+2); in progress = claimed leaves (requested by Santa for the owner).

## Done when

Epic rows in --tree show # for done, = for in progress, both percents and (+N); leaf rows keep the state column.
seen.title: qew progress --tree: an epic row shows a two-tone bar of done and in-progress with both percents
